description: Header file defining functions, structures, and constants for querying and translating OpenGL image formats to native formats within the ANGLE project. It includes support requirements, format info, and format conversion functions.

classes.name: SupportRequirement
classes.description: Structure representing the support requirements for a specific format, including version and extension dependencies.

classes.name: InternalFormat
classes.description: Structure holding support requirements for various internal formats such as texture, filter, attachment, and renderbuffer.

classes.name: TexImageFormat
classes.description: Structure representing the format and type for texture images.

classes.name: TexSubImageFormat
classes.description: Structure representing the format and type for sub-image texture updates.

classes.name: CompressedTexImageFormat
classes.description: Structure representing the internal format for compressed texture images.

classes.name: CompressedTexSubImageFormat
classes.description: Structure representing the format for compressed sub-image textures.

classes.name: CopyTexImageImageFormat
classes.description: Structure representing the internal format for copied texture images.

classes.name: TexStorageFormat
classes.description: Structure representing the internal format for texture storage.

classes.name: RenderbufferFormat
classes.description: Structure representing the internal format for renderbuffers.

classes.name: ReadPixelsFormat
classes.description: Structure representing the format and type for reading pixels.

methods.name: GetInternalFormatInfo
methods.description: Returns support information for a given internal format and standard GL.

methods.name: GetTexImageFormat
methods.description: Determines the appropriate texture image format based on provided internal format, format, type, and features.

methods.name: GetTexSubImageFormat
methods.description: Determines the format and type for sub-image texture updates.

methods.name: GetCompressedTexImageFormat
methods.description: Returns support info for compressed texture images.

methods.name: GetCompressedSubTexImageFormat
methods.description: Returns support info for compressed sub-image textures.

methods.name: GetCopyTexImageImageFormat
methods.description: Returns support info for copying texture images.

methods.name: GetTexStorageFormat
methods.description: Returns support info for texture storage formats.

methods.name: GetRenderbufferFormat
methods.description: Returns support info for renderbuffer formats.

methods.name: GetReadPixelsFormat
methods.description: Returns format and type info for reading pixels.
